title: GBR-12909 — reviewed identity

evidence.context: Identity only. The reviewed source fixes the structure of the named reference; it establishes no transporter affinity, selectivity or potency.

note: GBR-12909 and vanoxerine are the same compound. The historical GBR-12909 row carried C28H33FN2O with a single meta fluorine on the phenylpropyl ring and an unsubstituted benzhydryl, which is neither GBR-12909 nor GBR-12935; the reviewed ChEBI structure is C28H32F2N2O with two para fluorines on the benzhydryl. The witness is the library's own ChEBI-sourced vanoxerine row, pinned by origin commit and file digest, so no claim rests on an unpinned fetch.
